definitions.explanation: Attempting something again after a previous failure or setback. Emphasizes determination and willingness to try once more.

examples.japanese: ⟦{来年|らいねん}→来年：00745_rainen⟧{再挑戦|さいちょうせん}⟦する→する：00392_suru⟧⟦つもり→つもり：01152_tsumori⟧だ。
examples.english: I plan to try again next year.

examples.japanese: ⟦{試験|しけん}→試験：01422_shiken⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{落|お}ちた→落ちる：01242_ochiru⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧、⟦すぐ→すぐ：00814_sugu⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧{再挑戦|さいちょうせん}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{決意|けつい}した→決意する：28116_ketsuisuru⟧。
examples.english: I failed the exam, but immediately resolved to try again.

examples.japanese: ⟦{何度|なんど}→何度：17592_nando⟧⟦{失敗|しっぱい}→失敗：01636_shippai⟧⟦して→する：00392_suru⟧⟦も→も：00484_mo⟧{再挑戦|さいちょうせん}⟦する→する：00392_suru⟧⟦{姿勢|しせい}→姿勢：00371_shisei⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{大切|たいせつ}→大切：01456_taisetsu⟧だ⟦と→と：00512_to⟧、⟦コーチ→コーチ：03844_koochi⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧{教|おし}わった。
examples.english: My coach taught me that the attitude of trying again no matter how many times you fail is what matters.

notes:
{再挑戦|さいちょうせん} means attempting something again after a previous failure. It carries a positive, determined nuance — the speaker refuses to give up.

FORMS:
⟦{再|さい}→再〜：03953_sai⟧ (again, re-) + ⟦{挑戦|ちょうせん}→挑戦：03495_chousen⟧ (challenge, attempt). The prefix ⟦{再|さい}→再〜：03953_sai⟧ is productive and creates many similar compounds:
- ⟦{再|さい}{開|かい}→再開：05219_saikai⟧: reopening
- ⟦{再|さい}{試験|しけん}→再試験：09972_saishiken⟧: retake (of an exam)
- ⟦{再|さい}{出発|しゅっぱつ}→再出発：19676_saishuppatsu⟧: fresh start

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {再挑戦|さいちょうせん}⟦する→する：00392_suru⟧: to try again
- {再挑戦|さいちょうせん}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{機会|きかい}→機会：01302_kikai⟧: opportunity to try again
- {再挑戦|さいちょうせん}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{決意|けつい}する→決意する：28116_ketsuisuru⟧: to resolve to try again

USAGE:
Often used for exams, competitions, certifications, and personal goals. Implies admirable perseverance rather than foolish repetition.
